hint_no_computers: Run AsenaScale on your PC and it shows up here by itself. Or tap a device below.
no_other_devices: No other devices on your tailnet.
key_dialog_windows: Windows PC: copy the setup command and paste it into an administrator PowerShell on the PC. It installs SSH and authorizes this key.
key_dialog_linux: Linux/macOS: add the line below to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys (not needed with Tailscale SSH).
auth_key_windows: The OpenSSH setup command also adds this phone's key.
auth_key_other: Add the app's key (key icon on the home screen) to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the computer.
auth_tailscale_help: Connects without a password when `sudo tailscale set --ssh` is on on the computer.
auth_password_help: The password is kept in the app's private storage on this phone.
tip_windows: Tip: if the link drops, `claude --continue` takes you back to the last conversation.
tip_tmux: Tip: with tmux the Claude session keeps running on the PC if the link drops, and you continue where you left off.
host_app_found_body: No setup needed. The first time, a permission window appears on the PC; just click “Yes”.
windows_card_body: Recommended: install AsenaScale on the PC. Open the link on the PC, download AsenaScale-Setup.exe and run it. It sits in the system tray; no commands or admin rights needed. Once installed, this screen finds it by itself.
launcher_note: Each one is its own lasting terminal on the PC: it keeps running even if you close the app.
no_window_list: The window list isn't available on this desktop; the whole screen or the active window still work.
shot_no_session: Nobody is signed in on Windows. Screenshots need a signed-in session on the PC.
shot_no_window: Window not found (it may have closed). Refresh the list.
shot_locked: The PC's screen seems locked. Try again when it's unlocked.
shot_no_powershell: PowerShell wasn't found on the PC.
err_tailscale_off: Tailscale isn't connected. Turn it on and sign in on the home screen.
hint_approve: Click “Yes” in the permission window on the PC (only the first time).
err_exec_timeout: Timed out: the computer didn't answer
err_unreachable: Can't reach the PC over Tailscale. Is AsenaScale (or Tailscale) running there? The PC may be asleep.
err_port_silent_windows: The Tailscale tunnel reaches the PC (%1$d ms) but port %2$d doesn't answer. Install AsenaScale on the PC (or run the Windows setup command).
err_port_silent: The Tailscale tunnel reaches the PC (%1$d ms) but port %2$d doesn't answer: the SSH server is off or a firewall blocks it.
err_refused_windows: Reached the PC, but nothing listens on port %1$d. Install AsenaScale on the PC (or run the Windows setup command).
err_refused: Reached the PC, but nothing listens on port %1$d: sudo systemctl enable --now sshd
err_unknown_host: No device called “%1$s”. Check the address.
err_denied: Not allowed on the PC. Reconnect and click “Yes” in the window on the PC.
err_auth: Sign-in failed. Check the user name and the key or password.
err_timeout: Timed out: is the computer on and connected to Tailscale?
err_refused_generic: Connection refused: is an SSH server running on the PC? (On Windows: install AsenaScale.)
